title: The Uses of Losing
sentences: Competitive sport is one of the few institutions that manufactures loss deliberately.
Half of everyone involved is guaranteed to fail every week.
The arrangement is defended on the grounds that it builds character.
That defence is asserted far more often than it is examined.
What losing reliably teaches is that effort and outcome are loosely coupled.
Whether this produces resilience or resignation depends almost entirely on context.
A child who loses among adults who explain it learns one lesson.
A child who loses in silence learns a different and more durable one.
The sport is identical in both cases; the surrounding language is not.
We credit the game with effects that belong to the people around it.
